book.name: Mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ
book.title: Ŋwa wu mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ Joŋ le

content: Kwɛse wumu bɛ kiŋga ki nyaŋ yimi yì fiɛɛnɛ nyaŋ joo
Nja n'yɛŋ kfuu chi fiɛɛ fimi fi jwe wù yunɛ le fɛwe. Gɛ̀ bee kwɛse wumu wu noŋ juu ye ye le njɛ nju, kwii nyu a bikaa bie kuu, wu booŋ kifo ki bvunfoŋ, jóŋ nyu yu yuufe ncho yifiɛɛ.
Wu gɛ̀ bee bɛ fwe, wu lune wa ki wu bôo, wu yuge nsaasɛ wu lumɛ, wu beede.

Ŋka n'yɛŋ kfuu chi fiɛɛ fimi fi jwe wù yunɛ le fɛwe. Gɛ̀ bee kiŋga ki nyaŋ yimi yì yɛɛde lo, yi fiɛɛnɛ nyaŋ joo. Yi kɛme bikwɛɛ bvusooshwi bɛ binchoo yuufe, bifo bi bvunfoŋ bì shige shige bvusooshwi nyu yi bikwɛɛ biyu le.

Yi jisɛ ŋgvuuŋ we, wu kalɛ kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bitɛde bi jóŋ yi we wu noŋ yi nshɛŋ le. Kiŋga ki nyaŋ yiyu ja yi lɛɛŋ fwe a kwɛse wù gɛ̀ lune wɛɛ le, wu lɛ kwɛse wuyu doo wu boo, wu ŋgêjɛ lo mwa wuyu, wù wu boyi.
Wu boo mwa wù jwɛŋsɛ, nyu wu wù gê wu sâge bituŋ bichii bɛ kitoomɛ ki kichwa. Geenɛ, no wu gɛ̀ boyɛ bo mo bo chufɛ mwa wuyu bo bɛɛŋ bɛ wu fɛ Nyo le, wu tu wu nyume mbebe kala we le.
Kwɛse wuyu mo wu fɛɛ lo wu gɛɛŋ wu tu wu nyu nchvuuŋ kijusɛ kì Nyo gɛ̀ kɛnyɛ wa fɛ wu le. Nyu fo fɛ ba lé ba jîiŋe fɛ wu le yi aju le nchvuge bɛ gii yifɛɛ kicho mbaŋbvusoo (1,260).
Jɛŋ ja yi kɛ woŋ wu Nyo le, nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù Maikɛl bɛ ŋgoo ye yi banchɛndaa bo juu bɛ kiŋga ki nyaŋ yì fiɛɛnɛ nyaŋ joo yɛɛ. Nyaŋ yiyu bɛ be banchɛndaa juu.
Geenɛ bo so kiŋga ki nyaŋ yiyu bɛ ŋgoo ye, bo gɛ ka bo kɛme kijusɛ woŋ wu Nyo le gɛ.

Bo bvusɛ kiŋga ki nyaŋ yì fiɛɛnɛ nyaŋ joo yɛɛ bo misɛ ki gwe fɛkuu yi nshɛŋ le. Kiŋga kinɛ nyu yo yì kege yɛɛ yì le debele ka nyu Sataŋ. Nyume wu wù lɛɛde bɛ bamii yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le kichii. Bo gɛ̀ misɛ wu bɛ banchɛndaa be bo gwe yi nshɛŋ le.
Nja n'yu jɛ jɛmɛ fɛwɛɛwe woŋ wu Nyo le yi duu lɛ,

content.text: “Le mɛɛse wù Nyo lé wu bvûsɛ bamii be,
wu dûnyɛ bvuŋga bwe bvu lɛme,
wu sâge bvunfoŋ bwe, Mbvusɛ we wu wù gɛ̀ ka dûnyɛ tɛ bvuŋga bwe bvu nsa.
Fi le noo mɛɛse nje ba le ba misɛ wa muh wɛɛ fɛkuu,
wù gɛ̀ lɛme a Nyo wese fwe fɛnshɛ bɛ antaŋ,
wu kooyi mwɛɛ yi booŋ ba bwee wese le.
Geenɛ, bo nyu bo so wa wu,
bɛ jɛ yi Nyo yì bo lɛme ajiŋ a nsa wuyu le.
Gɛ bo gɛ̀ baaŋ bo koŋe kinche kiboo,
je yì taŋlo bo faane lo ki bo kwe gɛ.
bamii bachii ba le fo, lâŋeye tɛ.
Geenɛ, ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le fɛ bɛŋ le nshɛŋ bɛ joo yì baaŋ,
nje debele le wu shii wa wu to fɛ bɛŋ le.
Wu nyu wu yisɛ bɛ shɛ́ŋ yì bɛɛne wu baaŋ,
nje wu kee lo lɛ kife ke shɛɛ wa shige.”

content: Kiŋga ki nyaŋ yì fiɛɛnɛ nyaŋ joo yɛɛ doo yi yɛŋ lɛ ba le ba misɛ wa yi, yi gwe yi nshɛŋ le, yi daa legɛ a kwɛse wɛɛ wù gɛ̀ boyɛ mwa wù jwɛŋsɛ le.
Geenɛ, bo nya bibɛɛ bi nfa bifɛɛ kwɛse wuyu le lɛ wu fûnɛ yu wu lêgɛ yo yɛɛ wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu nyûme nchvuuŋ yi biluŋ le bitɛde bɛ kiŋgade ba jiiŋe fɛ wu le.
Yo yiyu mo yi bvusɛ joo a mu njɛ joo yì bohge ajiŋ a kwɛse wuyu wu lɛ yi tûu wu yi gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛ wu.
Geenɛ, nshɛŋ fi kwɛse wuyu, yi gwenyɛ jwe we yi yaaŋ lo joo yi kiŋga ki nyaŋ kiyu gɛ̀ bvusɛ a yi mu.
Nyaŋ yiyu mo yi toonyɛ shɛ́ŋ bɛ kwɛse wuyu, yi mo yi ja yi la bvuju a kimbɛge ki booŋ ba kwɛse wuyu le, nyume bo bò gɛɛde banchi ba Nyo bo ka lɛme ajiŋ a nsa wu Jiso.
mo yi gɛɛŋ yi tu yi lɛme ŋgɛɛme yi joo yì baaŋ le.

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme fɛnɛ lɛ, “Mɛ mo ŋgɛɛŋ”.
